All doors shall have a minimum clear width of 900 mm
For double-leaf doors, the minimum clear width shall be 1800 mm.
A minimum clear level space of 1800 mm x 1800 mm shall be provided before and extending beyond a door
EXCEPTION: where a door shall open onto but not into a corridor, the required clear, level space on the corridor side of the door may be a minimum of 1500 mm corridor width.
Door handles, pulls, latches and lever type locksets (doorknob) shall be at 900 mm (centered) above floor finish level.
Corridors shall have minimum clear width of 1500 mm to allow a wheelchair user and a person without disabilities to pass.
Turnabout spaces shall be provided for wheelchairs to turn around
these spaces shall have a minimum dimension of 1800 mm x 1800 mm and shall be spaced at a maximum of 12000 mm
Turnabout spaces shall also be provided at or within 3500 mm of every dead-end corridor.
